scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test

SETUP_SECRET.description: Guards your Worker's setup page. Use a long random value, for example the output of `openssl rand -base64 36`, and keep it: the setup page at `/setup` asks for it.

CLASSES.description: The runner classes your box serves, comma-separated. Each becomes a `runs-on` label. The default, `boxrunner,boxrunner-light`, matches the agent's default configuration.

REPOS.description: Optional. Only these repositories (`owner/name`, comma-separated) of the private ones the App is installed on. Leave empty to serve them all.

ADMINS.description: Optional. GitHub logins (comma-separated) that may sign in to the dashboard besides the App's owner. Leave empty for the owner alone.

FALLBACK_MINUTES.description: Optional. Minutes without a heartbeat from the box, from 2 to 1440, after which workflows that read the `BOXRUNNER_DOWN` variable run on GitHub's runners. Needs the App's Variables permission; see docs/fallback.md. Leave empty to turn fallback off.

ALERT_MINUTES.description: Optional. Minutes without a heartbeat from the box, from 2 to 1440, after which the Worker posts to your alert webhook, set as the `ALERT_WEBHOOK` secret after deploying; see docs/alerts.md. Leave empty for 10. With fallback on, `FALLBACK_MINUTES` decides instead.
